The user requests hillslope-to-stream travel times with lateral flow convergence and inter-column groundwater exchange, which requires spatially explicit 2D/3D hydrologic modeling. This question requires either: (1) a spatially distributed watershed model (e.g., ParFlow-CLM, DHSVM, RHESSys), (2) a hillslope-resolving model with explicit lateral flow physics, or (3) a custom multi-column ELM-PFLOTRAN coupling beyond standard capabilities. No column configuration can answer the core scientific question as posed.
